## What we build

### AI/ML model development
End-to-end model design, training, and deployment. Deployed models include TimesFM deviation-score signals, multi-factor CryptoScore (OnChain/Value/Momentum), sentiment engines, and regime detection — all in production with real evaluation pipelines.

### Quantitative trading systems
Algorithmic strategies, backtesting infrastructure, and real-time data pipelines spanning 17 blockchains, 1,000+ coins, and 130+ technical indicators — running at a fraction of institutional data costs.

### Data engineering & analytics
Scalable pipelines from BigQuery to Postgres to Redis, automated ETL orchestration across 67 GitHub Actions, health monitoring with auto-issue filing, and 2,800+ combined nodes of production graph-analysed infrastructure.

### Product engineering & advisory
Full-stack product delivery across React 19, Next.js, FastAPI, Firebase, and AWS — PWA, gamification, real-time dashboards, proven across 12 shipped products with live users and CI/CD.

## Featured projects

### Gyanmarg — gamified learning platform
Converting dense Vedic and Indian knowledge into a game loop — 80+ interactive visualisations built from scratch, each explaining a philosophical concept without a single wall of text. Gamified learning platform with spaced repetition, active recall, and 60+ lesson subjects spanning Vedic wisdom to modern science, each with 10 levels of mastery. Built as a PWA with levelling, XP tracking, and progress analytics. Live: ai-polymind.web.app.

### Pratyaksha — cognitive journaling
4-agent LLM pipeline that outputs structured emotion maps without hallucination — each agent cross-validates the others, and the final layer rejects anything that doesn't match the user's actual journal text. Maps emotions, detects recurring themes, and surfaces actionable insights. Live: ai-becoming.web.app.

### CryptoPrism — on-chain quantitative intelligence
Crypto-native analytics platform ingesting 17 blockchains via BigQuery public datasets, processing 1,000+ coins daily with 130+ technical indicators, generating ML-powered signals through an ensemble of scoring models. Proprietary CryptoScore weights OnChain (40%), Value (30%), Momentum (30%). Includes Saarthi, an AI companion for natural-language market queries, and a real-time sentiment engine. An intelligent caching layer respects rate limits across 17 RPC endpoints while keeping all 1,000+ coins fresh within each 5-minute window — keeping infra under $100/mo where comparable institutional data providers charge $15,000–30,000/mo.
